_comment: Bundle path (or prefix) -> SPDX id. Permissive-only redistribution policy (TDD §13); `bundle.manifest build` refuses anything outside bundle.manifest.ALLOWED_LICENSES, so an incompatible artifact is caught at packaging time rather than by a judge. Verify each tag against the exact repo at download — model cards do change license between revisions.
_source_of_truth: For MODEL artifacts these values are derived from models/MANIFEST.json, which scripts/fetch_models.sh writes from the licence actually attached to the pinned revision. The asr and tts entries below were WRONG before T2 measured them (both were Apache-2.0 by assumption; Moonshine is MIT and the Piper voice is CC0). Reasoning: docs/model-provenance.md.
